contents.cpu: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz, 4 vCPU (4 cores, 1 thread per core, 1 socket); AVX, AVX2, AVX-512F/BW/CD/DQ/VL/VNNI
contents.notes: Shared cloud container: timing is noisy and is recorded as a diagnostic only. Floating-point results are reproducible bit for bit only on this CPU feature set with the same binary, because the gemm kernel dispatches on AVX-512.

manifest.hypothesis: Does factorized typed pair attention improve out-of-distribution routing accuracy by at least 0.02 over the identical computation with the pair bias multiplied by zero (factorized-v2-off) in A0 on operator-routing v2, without a per-fold OOD calibration regression? The A0-ablations-v2 study (d_model 32) found no necessity of typed attention, so a null is plausible. The full A0 bundle against the pinned plain baseline is labelled bundle vs baseline, non-isolating.
manifest.metrics: OOD accuracy (sole primary endpoint: mean over three folds, paired over five seeds, delta_min 0.02); gated per fold on test_ood with raw logits: NLL, ECE15; IID accuracy; raw coverage and selective error; matched parameters; descriptive: total_params, flops_per_example, latent_steps, wall time, explicit_token_count, temperature-fitted diagnostics; equal total_params and flops_per_example of the factorized pair
manifest.baseline: factorized-v2-off (identical compute, pair bias zeroed; isolating contrast); the pinned plain baseline research/baselines/plain_model (ptr-burn-a0@matched-cross-attention-v1) for the bundle contrast
manifest.falsification: Decided only by research/falsification/A0-baseline-v1/criteria.toml and PREREGISTRATION.md. SUPPORTS needs every gate: OOD accuracy delta >= 0.02 with the paired 95% interval lower bound > 0 and positive in every fold; per fold on test_ood and raw logits the NLL delta upper bound <= 0 and the ECE15 mean delta <= 0 with upper bound <= 0.02; IID accuracy lower bound >= -0.01; coverage and selective-error gates; matched compute. Accuracy up with any calibration gate failed is NO-GO-CALIBRATION (INCONCLUSIVE; no quality claim). FALSIFIES needs the OOD accuracy interval upper bound below 0.02 with both arms learnable and compute matched. A missing seed, fold, arm or digest is a refusal, not a verdict.
